why: A (universes 0; the defs minPathsHomotopyEquiv / minVelHomeomorph read as Nonempty of their types) lives on the project's embedded SU(2m) ⊆ M_{2m}(ℂ) with Ω = PathSp (Milnor's metric d) and Ω^d = minPaths (paths of least energy): exp(A/2) = A/π on minVel, E ≥ (π√(2m))² on Ω(I, −I), the exp tA (A ∈ minVel) are least-energy paths and every least-energy path is one of them on [0,1], A ↦ exp tA is continuous, minVel ≃ Ω^d up to homotopy and ≃ₜ its separation quotient (the Grassmannian enters only through lemma_23_1, outside the item). B: on every abstract M isometric to SU(2m) via ψ, Ω^d = {w ∈ Ω | E(w) ≤ ρ(p,q)²} with the blind d-topology admits continuous Φ : Ω^d → G_m(ℂ^{2m}) (rank-m Hermitian idempotents) and Ψ back with ΦΨ = id and ΨΦ = id on [0,1]. A ⇒ B fails genuinely only through the abstract setting (transport along ψ of ρ, Ω, E and the d-topology; uniqueness questions), and holds on the embedded SU(2m) (A_to_B_emb, proved). B ⇒ A fails genuinely: B is only an abstract homeomorphism statement; A's identification of the least-energy paths (exp tA, A² = −π²I), the energy bound, exp(A/2) = A/π and the continuity of the specific map A ↦ exp tA are not consequences of it.
